spanish: Y se afeitará, y el neteq no lo afeitará, y encerrará el sacerdote el neteq siete días una segunda vez.

findings.issue: הַנֶּתֶק (H5424) is a common noun, not a name; Spanish leaves it as the untranslated loanword neteq.

notes: Hithpael vs piel, the unnamed 3ms shaver, the priest as subject of the hiphil, seven days, and adverbial שֵׁנִית match.
